description: Raw prompts plus observables; parsing is not execution. Image cases need actual authorized artifacts.

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to give one English prompt for a complete concert poster. Locked title: AFTER HOURS. One figure under a warm lamp in a cool empty square; vertical format. Do not generate.
expected_observables: One finished-image prompt with exact title
No layer plan or required manual assembly

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to build separate poster elements for Canva. Concept locked: warm person against a cool empty square, 1024 x 1536. The title is undecided and will be editable text. Give only an English background prompt now; later we will make the person and fog. No codes even internally.
expected_observables: Shared composition and current background-only scope
No copy forced onto background; project title retained as pending
No code selection
must_not: Forced title approval before independent background

cases.prompt: Use this Skill for the agreed four-asset sequence. The background candidate has just been generated and is available for inspection. I have not approved it. What happens next?
expected_observables: Inspect actual supplied candidate when accessible
Request acceptance or corrections and wait
must_not: Assistant QA treated as user approval

cases.prompt: Use this Skill with the supplied registry and files. Background and person v001 are approved. Person v002 is in review; v003 was rejected. I want to keep person v001 and cancel v002. Prepare the next step without generating.
expected_observables: Keep v001 selected and record cancellation of v002
Preserve background bytes and version history

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to plan a fog overlay for the supplied separate-assets composition in my editor. Specify placement, alpha and blending. Do not generate.
expected_observables: Full-canvas versus crop decision
Intended background/blend requirements and actual host/editor uncertainty
Actual-file alpha and edge QA plan
must_not: PNG extension treated as alpha proof

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to plan separate assets: a generated subject, raster artistic title and editable date/venue text for Illustrator. All copy is supplied and locked. Plan only.
expected_observables: Per-asset typography/production routing
Copy retained across project and assigned to outputs
Raster lettering distinguished from editable text
must_not: Blocking all independent raster work because of editable text

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to assess the attached flattened poster. Separate its visible person and reconstruct the hidden background. Explain the outputs before generating.
expected_observables: Actual source inspection
Extracted versus reconstructed versus regenerated distinctions
Hidden pixels remain inferred

cases.prompt: Use this Skill to generate only the agreed subject asset. Native image generation is unavailable here; the approved concept, copy and reference file are supplied.
expected_observables: Honest unavailable state
Complete current-asset prompt only after applicable gates pass
Approved files preserved

cases.prompt: Use this Skill. To moje pierwsze użycie. Jak tworzyć osobne elementy plakatu do ręcznego składania? Nie chcę widzieć kodów.
expected_observables: Polish onboarding
Sequential review and explicit acceptance
Individual or ZIP choice after completion
No identifiers exposed

cases.prompt: Use this Skill with the actual supplied files and registry. All assets in the current sequence are approved, and the latest rejected alternatives are retained. Finish the handoff; I have not chosen the delivery format.
expected_observables: Ask individual files versus ZIP once
Only selected versions proposed
Actual inventory/byte verification before success

cases.prompt: Use this Skill in a new chat. My approved layer registry is attached, but one selected image is missing. A local personal extension prefers another review cadence. Resume my requested one-by-one workflow.
expected_observables: Check accessible assets and actual local instructions
Honor explicit current cadence
Explain missing file and recover or request decision
must_not: Silent regeneration as the approved original
Changing Skill source to store project state
